description: This file defines the RevertOverridesForm class, a Drupal form used to revert layout overrides to default settings within the layout builder module.

classes.name: Drupal\layout_builder\Form\RevertOverridesForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class that allows users to revert layout overrides to default settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with layout tempstore repository and messenger services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question for the form.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description message about reverting layout, with entity context if available.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to cancel the operation and go back.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, ensuring the section storage supports overrides and setting necessary form attributes.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission by removing all layout sections, deleting tempstore, and redirecting.
